name: Xiangtan Electric Manufacturing Co., Ltd.
summary: Xiangtan Electric Manufacturing Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the design, production, and sale of electrical products in China and internationally. The company offers generators, AC/DC motors, special motors, marine propulsion systems, electrical control equipment, and wind turbines, as well as water pumps. Its products are used in petrochemical explosion-proof, materials and metallurgical, marine power, energy and power, water conservancy and municipal, rail transit, and new energy industries. The company was founded in 1936 and is based in Xiangtan, China.
